description: 7-channel RS485 temperature acquisition module, Modbus RTU

sources.title: NT18B07 modbus rtu protocol
sources.note: Register table and examples; the Word file is attached to the map request. The submitter believes it is not an official document

notes: Function codes 0x03 (read) and 0x06 (write). Addresses are the ones in the manual's frames (channel 1 is read at 0x0000), so the map is 0-based.
Serial settings: 9600 bit/s (default), 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit; the address is 1-247 (the frames also allow 0xFE).
The document says a correction of 0 disables the function and also says the register must not be set to 0x0000; the default is 0.
The automatic report setting makes the module send temperatures without a request, so leave it at 0 on a bus with other masters or slaves.

registers.description: Tenths of a degree, two's complement (0x00DB is 21.9 °C, 0xFF90 is -11.2 °C). 0xF555 (-2731) means no sensor or an error

registers.name: Automatic report interval
registers.description: 0 = the module answers queries only (default); 1 to 255 = the module sends the temperatures by itself every n seconds

registers.name: Device address
registers.description: Modbus slave address. A read sent to the broadcast address 0xFF returns it (only with one module on the bus)

registers.name: Baud rate
registers.description: Applies after a power cycle. Writing 5 restores the factory settings
